_about: Libraries and data Motionmaker can install on request (pinned). Licences read from each package's npm metadata on checkedOn. Nothing here is bundled in Motionmaker: `lib.mjs setup <group>` installs into the kit cache ($MOTIONMAKER_KITS or ~/.cache/motionmaker/kits).

fonts.what: open-licence fonts, one per look, so type no longer depends on the machine
fonts.credit: none required; the licence travels with the font files (fonts/FONTS.md)

code.what: syntax highlighting for code reveals (rendered ahead of time in Node)

math.what: typeset equations (KaTeX, rendered ahead of time in Node)

maps.what: globe and map scenes (d3-geo + Natural Earth country shapes)
maps.credit: none required; 'Made with Natural Earth' is customary
maps.licenseNote: world-atlas shapes are derived from Natural Earth (public domain)

sketch.what: hand-drawn circles, underlines, arrows and boxes (Rough.js, fixed seed)

icons:material.what: Google Material Symbols (outlined, rounded, sharp; weight 400)
